meta: Aqua HK spent HK$5,680 on Meta for 21 schedules, about HK$270 each, inside the good band and level with last week's 22.
Dim Sum Library recovered sharply: 11 schedules on HK$2,408, about HK$219 each, against only 3 schedules the week before.
Meta is still a thin last-click channel here: 32 combined schedules against 368 GA4 bookings across the two venues.
google: Aqua HK Google ran HK$8,282 for about 63 booking conversions at roughly HK$131 CPA, inside the good band.
Dim Sum Library Google delivered about 62 conversions on HK$2,792 at roughly HK$45 CPA, still the cheapest acquisition in the portfolio.
Google conversions fell at both venues week on week (Aqua HK 73 to 63, Dim Sum Library 71 to 62). Part of that is late attribution that has not settled yet, so both CPAs will read lower in a week.
ga4: Aqua HK was flat at 213 bookings (-0.9% WoW), 5 percent under the August target of 224 and -11.3% YoY; it stays -6.7% on YTD.
Dim Sum Library rose to 155 (+4.7% WoW) but is 14 percent under target and -16.2% YoY, leaving it -7.2% on YTD.

The two gaps have different causes: Aqua HK's users are down 14.6% YoY so its shortfall is traffic-side, while Dim Sum Library's users are up 9.9% YoY on a 12.1% conversion rate, so its shortfall is conversion-side.
